title: Exploring the mechanism of action of Qufengzhitong pills in treating rheumatoid arthritis via the PI3K/AKT, NF-kappaB, and MAPK pathways.
authors: Li, Jie; Li, Rongxue; Wang, Yule; Rashed, Marwan M A; Qi, Dejun; He, Yuanjie; He, Chenghui; Chang, Yanxu; Nian, Sihui; Duan, Hong; Hu, Henggui; Zhai, Kefeng
journal: The Journal of pharmacy and pharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究祛风止痛丸治疗类风湿关节炎的机制，涉及分子对接但对象为药物-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: To elucidate the therapeutic mechanism of Qufengzhitong Pills (QFZTP) in the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis (RA). METHODS: Blood-absorbed active components of QFZTP and its potential therapeutic targets for RA were screened via liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) and network pharmacology. Core targets were analyzed using protein-protein interaction networks, with key pathways identified via Gene Ontology/Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes enrichment. Molecular docking was performed for major components and core targets. An IL-1beta-induced MH7A cell-based RA model was established; CCK-8, ELISA (IL-6/TNF-alpha), wound-healing/Transwell, flow cytometry, EdU, and western blot (PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB/MAPK pathways) were used to assess cell viability, cytokines, migration, apoptosis, proliferation, and protein expression. KEY FINDINGS: LC-MS/MS identified 92 active components in rat serum, and network pharmacology identified 369 potential QFZTP targets for RA, enriched mainly in TNF signaling, PI3K/AKT, MAPK, and apoptosis pathways. Core components (crocetin, epigallocatechin, bergapten) showed stable binding (<-5.0 kcal/mol) to AKT1, EGFR, and PI3K, occupying similar active pockets as native inhibitors. In vitro, QFZTP-containing serum significantly reduced IL-1beta-induced MH7A cell viability; inhibited IL-6/TNF-alpha secretion (comparable to native QFZTP solution); attenuated migration/proliferation; induced apoptosis; downregulated EGFR, p-PI3K, p-AKT, p-p38, p-NF-kappaB, and Bcl-2; and up-regulated Bax. CONCLUSION: QFZTP synergistically regulates the PI3K/AKT, NF-kappaB, and MAPK pathways to inhibit synovial cell proliferation and migration, induce apoptosis, and attenuate inflammation. This study provides a robust theoretical and experimental basis for its clinical application in RA.
abstract_zh: 目的：阐明祛风止痛片（QFZTP）治疗类风湿关节炎（RA）的治疗机制。方法：通过液相色谱-串联质谱（LC-MS/MS）和网络药理学筛选QFZTP的血中吸收活性成分及其治疗RA的潜在靶点。利用蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络分析核心靶点，并通过基因本体论/京都基因与基因组百科全书富集分析识别关键通路。对主要成分和核心靶点进行分子对接。建立IL-1β诱导的MH7A细胞RA模型；采用CCK-8、ELISA（IL-6/TNF-α）、伤口愈合/Transwell、流式细胞术、EdU和蛋白质印迹（PI3K/AKT/NF-κB/MAPK通路）评估细胞活力、细胞因子、迁移、凋亡、增殖和蛋白表达。主要发现：LC-MS/MS在大鼠血清中鉴定出92种活性成分，网络药理学识别出369个QFZTP治疗RA的潜在靶点，主要富集于TNF信号、PI3K/AKT、MAPK和凋亡通路。核心成分（藏红花酸、表没食子儿茶素、佛手柑内酯）与AKT1、EGFR和PI3K显示稳定结合（<-5.0 kcal/mol），占据与天然抑制剂相似的活性口袋。体外实验中，含QFZTP血清显著降低IL-1β诱导的MH7A细胞活力；抑制IL-6/TNF-α分泌（与天然QFZTP溶液相当）；减弱迁移/增殖；诱导凋亡；下调EGFR、p-PI3K、p-AKT、p-p38、p-NF-κB和Bcl-2；并上调Bax。结论：QFZTP通过协同调节PI3K/AKT、NF-κB和MAPK通路，抑制滑膜细胞增殖和迁移，诱导凋亡，并减轻炎症。本研究为其在RA中的临床应用提供了坚实的理论和实验基础。
